breaking.change: Each screen and component document is typed from its contract: `og ui types` writes `.og/types/ui/<name>.d.ts` (its props, the events it can send, its slots) and og check, run, build and dev write them before they check. These functions take the document's name as a type parameter, so for a declared name the viewmodel or props must match the contract (every prop given, of its type; a list's items as its fixtures show them) and og.ui.screenVm answers that type. A partial viewmodel or a prop of the wrong type no longer type-checks. A name no document declares stays untyped, as before. The wire is unchanged.
breaking.fix: Pass the whole viewmodel the document's `props` block declares (or declare the prop `any` there). A game made before this release adds ".og/types/**/*.d.ts" to its tsconfig's include to get the types.
